title: fix(nextjs): prevent infinite loading when search client fails
body:
## Summary
This PR fixes issue #6525 where the Next.js InstantSearch app would hang indefinitely during SSR when the search client fails (e.g., no network connection, API timeout, or server unavailable).

## Changes
- Add 30-second timeout for SSR search operations to prevent infinite waiting
- Add error handlers for search client failures in both composition and standard clients
- Introduce `ssrSearchFailed` flag to track when SSR search fails and skip result injection
- Add error listeners for helper and derived helper error events
- Wrap all SSR operations in try-catch blocks to ensure graceful degradation
- Make SSR results truly optional - the app continues to render even when search fails

## Impact
Before this fix, if the search API was unreachable during SSR, the Next.js app would hang indefinitely, resulting in a poor user experience and potentially server timeouts.

After this fix, the app gracefully handles connection failures and continues to render the page without SSR results, allowing client-side hydration to work normally once the connection is restored.

Fixes #6525
